description.en: How Warren Buffett approaches investment decisions and business judgments
description.zh: 沃伦·巴菲特如何处理投资决策和商业判断

step_1.action: If no, stop. If yes, proceed.

questions: Does it have a durable competitive advantage?
What is the moat and how durable is it?
Does it earn high returns on capital?
Would I trust them with my family's money?
What is the margin of safety at current price?

options: Buy if margin of safety is sufficient
Wait if price is too high

philosophy.zh: 以十年为单位思考，而非天数

buffett_quote.en: Our favorite holding period is forever.
buffett_quote.zh: 我们最喜欢的持有期是永远。

description.en: Business must be within circle of competence

description.zh: 诚实、能干、以所有者为导向的管理层

buffett_quote.en: You do things when the opportunities come along. I've had periods in my life when I had a bunch of ideas, and I've had long dry spells.
buffett_quote.zh: 当机会出现时你采取行动。我一生中有些时候有很多想法，也有很长时间的枯竭期。

description.en: Makes decisions independently, not by committee
description.zh: 独立做决定，而非通过委员会

philosophy.en: Quick to say no, patient to say yes

buffett_quote.en: The important thing is to keep playing, to play against the Better Player, and to learn from him. But the most important thing is to keep playing.
buffett_quote.zh: 重要的是继续玩，与更强的玩家对战，向他学习。但最重要的是继续玩。

approach.en: Admit mistakes openly, learn from them, move on
approach.zh: 公开承认错误，从中学习，继续前进

buffett_quote.en: I make plenty of mistakes, and I'll make plenty more. The key is to learn from them.
buffett_quote.zh: 我犯了很多错误，还会犯更多。关键是从中学习。

examples.lesson: Don't overpay even for good businesses
Don't buy when oil prices are at peak

buffett_quote.en: Charlie has pushed me in the direction of buying wonderful businesses at fair prices rather than fair businesses at wonderful prices.
buffett_quote.zh: 查理推动我以合理价格购买优秀企业，而不是以优秀价格购买平庸企业。

impact: Shifted from cigar butt investing to quality investing
Emphasized mental models and multi-disciplinary thinking
Focused on business quality over price alone
